title: Loop fuel configuration
statement: Let $body$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $F$ on input $x$. The construction defines a configuration on the same input with $body.k+1+(1+F.k)$ work tapes by adjoining $1+(body.k+1)$ blank tapes to the work tapes of $c$, with each added tape head at position zero; the state, input-head position, and output are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machines $body$ and $F$ over the Boolean alphabet
